svg.title: One finite parameter domain for every pure-symbol degree
svg.desc: A finite homogeneous ordinary-symbol presentation is put in a monic elimination basis over the parameter fraction field. Inverting its finitely many coefficient denominators gives a single parameter open D(f). At every field-valued point of D(f), the specialized elimination relations are exactly the annihilators of the pure transformation-action symbols in every degree. This is not an identification with all orbit symbols.

g.text: One parameter open, every pure-symbol degree
Parameters in R; polynomial variables (tangent t, normal z)
Eliminate z and unwanted vector components
Invert one finite product f of parameter denominators
Monic leading terms and all finite reduction identities survive specialization.
Every field-valued point of D(f), every degree j
specialized elimination relations = annihilator of H_j
H_j is the pure-action symbol. The full orbit symbol may have extra directions.
